summary: Iteration 35: Rider first-login guide + Web Bluetooth ESC/POS thermal printing. Backend: 6/6 pytest pass (identify returns rider role+id used by guide, rider/owner login, wrong PIN rejected, owner logout -> 401). Frontend (Playwright, mocked navigator.bluetooth since no physical printer): Rider guide auto-opens at PIN stage on 390px with 3 steps, rider-guide-complete closes + sets si4am_rider_guide_<id>=seen, no auto-open on return, rider-guide-open reopens manually, Escape closes, Rider PIN login succeeds; Owner sees no guide/link. Settings without Bluetooth: guidance text, connect+test disabled, no page errors, 0px overflow. Mock: NotFoundError cancel -> no toast/no crash; connect -> 'Tersambung: MockPrinter58', label 'Ganti Printer'; Test Print sends ESC @ / ESC a 0 / text / GS V 0; second print reuses characteristic (no new requestDevice); Disconnect calls gatt.disconnect and resets status. Invoice receipt with mock shows receipt-print-bt, sends 340 bytes in 100-byte chunks [100,100,100,40], 2nd print reuses connection; without Bluetooth the button is hidden (PNG/WhatsApp remain). One functional bug: 'Ganti Printer' does NOT open the device chooser while connected. PHYSICAL PRINTER VERIFICATION STILL REQUIRED (all BT results are mock-based). DB reset to Owner-only baseline afterwards.

ui_bugs.issue: When connected, clicking Connect (label 'Ganti Printer') calls connectBluetoothPrinter which returns early because btChar && gatt.connected; requestDevice is never called (verified: requests count unchanged) and a misleading 'Printer X tersambung' toast is shown. User cannot change printer without first disconnecting.

receipt-print-bt catch shows toast for every error incl. NotFoundError (user cancelled chooser) – inconsistent with Settings card which suppresses it. Also no busy/disabled state or success toast; double clicks can send duplicate prints.

issues: Disabled 'Test Print' (btn-ghost) looks fully enabled (white text, no opacity) – only Sambungkan shows disabled styling
Notifikasi toggle knob sits on/over right card border (appears clipped at card edge)
'Panduan Rider baru' link tap target is only ~111x16px; recommend min 44px height for mobile

action_items: Add a force/change option: connectBluetoothPrinter({ force: true }) that disconnects current device and calls requestDevice when the button label is 'Ganti Printer'
In ReceiptModal print handler, ignore NotFoundError and add busy state + success toast

Consider smaller BLE chunks (e.g. 20-180 bytes depending on characteristic) and writeValueWithoutResponse/writeValueWithResponse instead of deprecated writeValue; many cheap 58mm printers fail with 100-byte writeWithoutResponse chunks unless MTU negotiated – verify on real hardware
critical_code_review_comments: helpers.js connectBluetoothPrinter early-return makes 'Ganti Printer' a no-op (see ui_bugs)
gattserverdisconnected only clears btChar; next print calls requestDevice again instead of reconnecting btDevice.gatt.connect() – acceptable (user gesture) but a silent reconnect would be better UX
printBluetooth strips all non-ASCII (emoji/accents) – fine for ESC/POS, but '—' and '📅' disappear leaving leading spaces in lines
Rider guide 'seen' flag is localStorage-only, so it re-appears on every new device/browser for the same rider (by design per request, but not truly 'first login')

rca of the issue: Ganti Printer: BluetoothPrinter.connect() always calls connectBluetoothPrinter(); helpers.js line ~92 returns current status when btChar && btDevice.gatt.connected, so requestDevice chooser never opens. Repro: connect mock printer, click Connect again -> requests stays 1. Fix: pass a force flag from the card when status.connected and disconnect before requestDevice.
